article.title: Can a USB-C Laptop Charger Power a Handheld PC?
article.html:
Check the charging standards first

A compatible charger and device negotiate voltage and current before normal charging begins.

Fallback charging may be slower

Confirm the supported profiles, cable rating, and required wattage in the official specifications.
article.searchDescription: Learn how to check USB-C charger, cable, and handheld PC compatibility before connecting them.
